edits.new:
Then it passes on this baseline

  Scenario: AC12 The architecture rules without a criterion are checked by the contract (new, NEWAC-RWB-P5-E2025-CON-AC12)
    Given the business rules BR2, BR3, BR4, BR6, BR9, BR10, BR11 and BR12 of section 8
    When the published document, its AsyncAPI fragment and its fixture are checked against them
    Then the service topic is rwb.document.events.v1 with the retry and .dlt topics of the platform convention
    Then a change inside major version 1 is additive and a removed, renamed or retyped property is refused
    Then the document declares only tables of rwb_document and only operations owned by rwb-document
    Then no business value of the type table or the parameter table is fixed in the schema
    Then every consumed row states one hop, a 2 s timeout, one GET retry with jitter, a breaker per downstream and MSG-GEN-006 for a failed read
    Then every error uses one envelope and one message ID per condition
    Then the checked-field read declares no Idempotency-Key, writes nothing and has no side effect
    Then the contract declares no case state and no extraction state machine

  Scenario: AC13 A field state change the model does not allow is refused (new, NEWAC-RWB-P5-E2025-CON-AC13)
    Given the state values of CheckedField declared in AC2
    When a field state outside OK, CONFIRMED and CORRECTED is presented to the contract
    Then the contract refuses it and the read never returns a field in that state
    Then no transition between field states is declared by this contract, the transition belonging to RWB-P5-E1054-APP under BR12
    Then the refusal returns no CheckedFieldSet and no partial field list
